title: Spectral entropy weighting does not establish a respiratory-rate advantage over uniform PPG fusion in two cohorts
abstract: Normalized-entropy weighting of three PPG respiratory-modulation spectra did not establish improved respiratory-rate accuracy over uniform fusion in either independent cohort. Equal-record MAE reductions were 0.125 breaths/min (95% record-bootstrap CI -0.053 to 0.303) in BIDMC and 0.089 (-0.037 to 0.217) in CapnoBase. This is exploratory external transport on previously exposed datasets, not untouched confirmation or evidence of equivalence.
